scope: VCVio deprecation migration, stage S6, fixes of the two independent reviews at ed682b31 (statement equivalence EQ-S6-1, EQ-S6-2; hygiene H1, H2; all nits, no owner item). No Lean file, inventory row or check script changed: the fixes correct the reasons of four entries of the stage's phase B exception list (and record the same correction of five entries of stage S5's list for the final residual report), name the third declaration that excludes the pin's simplification bridges, and record the stages that switch back four twin-consumer files outside the plan's per-stage file lists. Supplements vcvio-deprecations-s6.json (the record of ed682b31).

commits.fixes: the commit that adds this receipt

fixes.EQ-S6-1: S6/tools/phaseb_exceptions_s6.py (original kept as phaseb_exceptions_s6.py.ed68.txt): total variation (tvDist, SPMF.tvDist) is kept apart from the SPMF type and its instances; the reason 'proof through total variation tvDist' is given only where tvDist or a lemma about it (the tvDist lemmas, abs_probOutput_toReal_sub_le_tvDist, tvDist_simulateQ_run_le_probEvent_output_bad) occurs; SPMF rows of other declarations are attributed to the pin's adapter semantics of StatefulGoodEvent.event_good or to the statement of probEvent_output_bad_eq'; the tool fails on an SPMF row with neither source and on an SPMF statement without tvDist. Rerun on S6/stage/phaseb-report.json: 39 declarations, 259 rows, only the reason lists of the four declarations in phase_b_exceptions.changed_reason_lists differ.
fixes.EQ-S6-2 and H1: four twin-consumer files have no deprecated use of their own and are in no stage's file list of plan/stage-files.tsv; their switch-back owners are recorded in twin_consumers_outside_stage_files (S6/NOTES.md, PROGRESS.md and the staged verification record); each later stage takes its switch-back set from the twin references in the whole tree, not only from its plan file list.
fixes.H2: the S6 entry of the staged verification record and the S6 section of the analysis now name the three declarations whose simp calls exclude evalDist_apply_singleton, evalDist_apply_setOf and evalDist_apply_univ: RawCtxSelectedAliasCompiler.source_distance, RawCtxStoppedParentSecrecy.local_bound and RawCtxSelectiveTargets.event_partition (three simp calls). No proof changed.

phase_b_exceptions.doctored_controls: 4 doctored copies of the stage's phase B report (logs/phaseb-exceptions-controls.log): an SPMF-only proof without tvDist, adapter instance or identical-until-bad lemma (c1) and an SPMF statement row without tvDist (c2) fail; the forbidden simp bridge evalDist_apply_singleton (c3) still fails; an adapter-class declaration that also uses tvDist (c4) passes with the total-variation reason and no SPMF-source reason. The earlier tool accepted c1 and c2.
